name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
benefit: Tuition and non-refundable fees plus academic allowance of Rs 86,000 in year 1 and Rs 41,000 in later years
eligibility_text: SC students who passed Class 12 and are admitted to a full-time course at a notified top institution; family income up to Rs 8 lakh
documents: Caste certificate; income certificate; bank account; admission rank; fee details
